evidence: internal/staging notes: Package staging ports git-diff-prep: classify, cluster, batch, write manifest.
internal/cluster evidence: UnionFind, BuildCorpusIndex, ClusterDocs, ClusterFiles
internal/diff notes: Package diff builds combined diffs from staging manifests.
internal/sa notes: Package sa runs staticAnalysis tools from central config against changed files.
internal/orchestrate evidence: BatchEntry, BatchPlan, StageFinalize, StagePrep, StageProse, StageReport, StageSynth
internal/filereview notes: Package filereview is the Prepare → Judge → Validate → Assemble state machine for per-file PR review batches.
internal/judge notes: Package judge is the Majordomo boundary onto strop JobRunner and evaluation packs.
internal/reviewrun notes: Package reviewrun is the local/CI review job: clone, SA, orchestrate, optional publish.
internal/report notes: Package report converts review findings to JUnit XML and Markdown reports to HTML.
internal/publish notes: Package publish posts PR/MR summaries via forge CLIs (gh, glab) or Bitbucket HTTP.
payload.objective: The review slice manages the end-to-end lifecycle of code reviews by executing static analysis, orchestrating review stages, aggregating evaluation results, and adapting findings into reports or published summaries.
